aboutGame.title: What is Sovereign Tower?
paragraphs: Sovereign Tower is a story-rich medieval management RPG where players become the ruler of a magical tower. You recruit unique knights, assign quests, and make choices that shape your kingdom.

The game combines kingdom management, character relationships, and time manipulation mechanics. Players can rewrite decisions, discover secrets, and create different outcomes through multiple timelines.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Sovereign Tower.

items.question: What is Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is a medieval management RPG about ruling a magical tower, recruiting knights, assigning quests, and shaping kingdom outcomes through story choices.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower beginners should learn how the Sovereign role works, recruit early knights, understand quest assignments, and watch how each decision changes kingdom progress.

items.question: How do knights work in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower knights are recruited characters who support kingdom quests, story events, and Round Table decisions. Managing their roles and relationships is central to progression.

items.question: How do quests affect Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower quests drive story progression, kingdom management, and character outcomes. Choices made during quests can open different paths and reveal new events.

items.question: Does Sovereign Tower have time rewind mechanics?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower uses time rewind choices so players can revisit decisions, use knowledge from previous outcomes, and pursue stronger kingdom results across timelines.

items.question: Where can players get Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is available on Steam for PC, with official game information and updates published through the Steam page and WILD WITS GAMES channels.
